tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H = 0.48, far short of the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe directly resolves the consequential ambiguity between transient positive gain and endogenous reversal.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow timescale or establish the forecast-horizon reversal.
A short-horizon trajectory would be less decisive about slow adaptation at H = 23.9.
They remain plausible on the pilot alone but cannot establish whether a slow reversal occurs.
